answer: Because the quill stake is held until the hollow settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the cedar audit lists each exposure. A farm running 134 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 21% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
